name: Battlefield of Ayn Tayan
title: Battlefield of Ayn Tayan
summary: The battlefield where the undead factions held Bael'Zharon for three days in the Third Sending of Darkness. Acpedia describes a Bael'Zharon statue among bones at the foot of a skeleton-covered hill, and green mist and cairns where Nerash fell at the top. In the kit, the Statue of Death (4.8 m) stands in a carpet of 322 bone piles at z 20. Six pressure plates and whirling-blade traps ring it, and three 8 m giant wooden masks form a triangle around it. The hilltop 130 m west (z 57) holds four dark cairn stones, a 6.8 m stone head (model 0x020003B2, the acpedia 'large Empyrean head') and a light (the green mist).
